confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Jaisalmer and Rajasthan tourist pricing, with no live listings checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is off-season and the Fort-area guesthouse market varies widely. Drinks are the weakest: alcohol pricing in Rajasthan is irregular, and the wine and cocktail anchors use beer-relative judgment. The FX value comes from a search snippet attributed to the RBA 4pm rate for 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly, so it should be verified against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asia basis, benchmarked against Jodhpur and Jaipur tourist districts and adjusted for Jaisalmer's Old Town and Fort-area guesthouse market. Prices reflect July off-season rates, which are lower than the October to March peak. Accommodation figures include GST.
